analysis: The experiment never reached training or trusted evaluation. Smoke testing failed because DV.assert_trainable was applied to the raw watch-ratio array, which contains NaN/Inf values, plausibly on invalid duration-zero rows. Thus the valid-mask handling was ordered incorrectly: the run establishes only that the raw ratio cannot be asserted as fully finite before masking, not whether soft-label shaping improves ranking.
next_lesson: Validate the mask first, assert finiteness only on valid ratios, and replace invalid ratio values safely before constructing the masked target.
